# builtin

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./singularity build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Built-in wallpaper source: contributes the Built-in tab to the desktop wallpaper picker, a grid of the bundled wallpapers (and the theme-following gradient); picking one writes its id to the wallpaper config with no server upload.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `Wallpaper.Provider` "Built-in"
  - Uses:
    - `apps/desktop/wallpaper.builtinWallpaperUrl`
    - `apps/desktop/wallpaper.Wallpaper`
    - `apps/desktop/wallpaper.WallpaperCandidate`
    - `config_v2.useConfig`
    - `primitives/css/center.Center`
    - `primitives/css/grid.Grid`
    - `primitives/css/text.Text`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Uses tokens:
    - `ui/tokens/color-palette --border`
    - `ui/tokens/color-palette --muted`
    - `ui/tokens/color-palette --primary`
    - `ui/tokens/shape --radius`
